definitions.explanation: Having the shape of a rod or stick. Used as a noun or with の to modify another noun.

examples.japanese: {棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
{棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{曲|ま}げる→曲げる：02529_mageru⟧。
examples.english: To bend a rod-shaped piece of metal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}って→切る：02693_kiru⟧スティック⟦サラダ→サラダ：01364_sarada⟧にした。
examples.english: I cut the vegetables into stick shapes and made a stick salad.

notes:
A descriptive compound of ⟦{棒|ぼう}→棒：03726_bou⟧ (rod; stick) and ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (shape; form). The suffix ⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ is productive and attaches to many nouns to mean "in the shape of" or "in the form of."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut into stick shapes
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物体|ぶったい}→物体：13506_buttai⟧: a rod-shaped object
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to stretch into a rod shape

RELATED SHAPE WORDS:
- {球状|きゅうじょう}: spherical
- {板状|ばんじょう}: plate-shaped; flat
- {筒状|つつじょう}: cylindrical; tube-shaped
- ⟦{粒状|りゅうじょう}→粒状：16659_ryuujou⟧: granular; grain-shaped
